source: ANAF (company status) + ISCIR (authorisations) + RENAR (accreditation body) + CNCAN (nuclear/radiation authority)
confidence: Level B for the active/inactive status (ANAF+ISCIR rule); Level C for the RENAR/CNCAN signals (matched by name, not tax ID - awaiting review)

inspection_provider.note: The only category relevant to the size of the NDT market as a service market. Aggregate turnover for the other categories is not published here: for 'in-house laboratory', it is the turnover of the whole parent company (often a large industrial operator), not of the NDT activity itself.

limitations: The RENAR and CNCAN links are made by normalised company name, not tax ID (CUI) - Level C, awaiting review.
No individual company name is published in this dataset.
Categories or counties with fewer than 4 distinct entities are suppressed, not shown as zero.
